facts.fact: The gender ministry's feasibility study states that local governments transfer project funds to community group accounts using the Integrated Financial Management System (IFMS), that their accounting officers prepare and submit quarterly warrants on it, and that as of July 2022 all local governments had been migrated to the IFMS; it gives no count of local governments and does not describe the link each uses.
facts.system: Local government access to the Integrated Financial Management System

facts.fact: The study team, visiting Koboko and Yumbe districts on 25 to 29 April 2022, found that Koboko district offices have access to internet, though its Community Service Department has no active access to NITA-U's internet, and that Yumbe's local government offices were reported not to have adequate hardware, software or internet for the programme's work; the study covers these two district local governments only.
facts.system: NITA-U internet at district local government offices

facts.fact: The study names the internet at Koboko district offices in April 2022 as that of the National Information Technology Authority (NITA-U), a government body, and assigns NITA-U the role of ensuring last-mile internet connectivity for the district local governments running social protection payments.
facts.system: NITA-U internet at district local government offices
